scope: Approved native macOS FolioNotes scope; deferred modules/platforms remain gated
method: Subjective weighted planning estimate; not verified security/correctness, percentage of code, or a release certificate.

areas.area: Mac integration, security review and release evidence

last_completed: The equal-width segments from 13k were reported still wrong: the owner sees 'Connections' too close to its edge rather than three segments that match. segmentDistribution = .fillEqually equalises segments to the widest segment's total width, which already includes the stock control's padding, so all three measured the same while only Connections sat tight against its own edges -- equal widths, unequal-looking padding. The widths are now set outright: equalizeSegmentWidths measures every label with the control's font, takes the widest, and sets each segment to widest + labelPadding x 2 from a single constant at the top of the file. The cursor and tooltip changes from 13k were confirmed working by the owner. Unverified source.
current_work: Owner rebuilds to check the segment spacing: whether the three segments now read as the same size with even padding. The bar is wider than the per-label original because it is equalised to the longest word, and the labelPadding constant at the top of App/Views/SectionSegmentedControl.swift is the one number that changes it if it reads as too wide. After that the original report's unwalked checklist items (Split in a normal window, clicking controls after resizing to the floor, the create/edit/save/reopen/search regression set), and the owner's stated next priority is the encrypted .rdm area.
